channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nikola Vucevic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nikola Vucevic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
‪Bobby Krivitsky‬:Joe Mazzulla on Nikola Vucevic:

“As he continues to get better and better, it's just another piece that we can unlock, and you kind of saw it tonight.”

Joe Mazzulla on Nikola Vucevic, Mar 2, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Boston Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla said.

“It changes the way you have to guard them when he’s playing at a high level. They’re playing faster. They’re shooting more. I think their guys are playing better, and I think it starts with Vučević.”

Joe Mazzulla on Nikola Vucevic, Apr 16, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Garrett Temple, Nikola Vucevic, Zach LaVine
item.description:
“You’re coming in and you’re asked to do more. That’s with any job on the planet. When they pay you a little bit more, you’re asked to do a little bit more. For me it’s kind of walking in and leaning into it.“They’ve asked me to be more of a leader. I’ve been able to see how guys — obviously DeMar [DeRozan] — seen how he led. With Zach [LaVine], see how Vooch [Nikola Vucevic] leads. Early on it was Thad Young, Garrett Temple, you see the way they led. You pick up little things from them knowing that, and hoping that my time will come to lead, and that time has come. It’s a challenge for sure, something new, but I always try and lean into it.”

Patrick Williams on DeMar DeRozan, Garrett Temple, Nikola Vucevic, Zach LaVine, Oct 5, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Nikola Vucevic, Andre Drummond
item.description:
“The starting lineup has changed, so there are groupings that just haven’t played a lot of minutes together.“That’s why you see us do a little more with the ‘Jumbo Lineup’ with Drum [Andre Drummond] and Vooch [Nikola Vucevic] just because putting two bigs in there covers up a lot of our interior weaknesses. Some of it is time together and the other part is just matchups. Orlando finished the game [Saturday] with four 6-9, 6-10 guys. We don’t have a lineup right now that can match that. A lot of the NBA is matchup and being able to compete through stuff because a lot of stuff is going to be out of your control. You just got to go with the flow.”

Alex Caruso on Nikola Vucevic, Andre Drummond, Feb 13, 2024. Source: Chicago Sun-Times.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
With reporters moments later, LaVine said:

“We understand that. I’ve been traded. [Nikola Vučević] has been traded. DeMar has been traded. We care for each other, but we know what’s on the other side of that.”

Zach LaVine on Nikola Vucevic, Nov 3, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
“During his time in Chicago, Nikola has proven that he is a special player both on and off the court,”

Arturas Karnisovas on Nikola Vucevic, Jun 28, 2023. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Pat Bev said on his podcast.

“I’mma give him all the energy he needs. Destroy people. Me and DeMar DeRozan, we good. I got a popping five in Vucevic. I’m excited, I’m really excited.”

Zach LaVine on DeMar DeRozan, Nikola Vucevic, Feb 21, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
DeRozan on why he backed Vucevic during slump:

“I know how hard Vooch works. I would never let a period of time of him struggling depict who he is as a player. He’s a dominant force at his position, one of the most skilled big men inside and out that we have in this league.”

DeMar DeRozan on Nikola Vucevic, Dec 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Arturas Karnisovas:

“It’s easy to add Nikola to the way we play. We put in an offense that is free flowing.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Nikola Vucevic, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Arturas Karnisovas on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Rob Schaefer:Arturas Karnisovas on Bulls’ acquisition of Nikola Vucevic:

“Usually you don’t get too many chances at All-Star level players and we were fortunate to get it done.”

Arturas Karnisovas on Nikola Vucevic, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @rob_schaef.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Raptors coach Nick Nurse said.

“It looked like Kawhi thought it was a switch and went under to hold up Vucevic, and Marc was still in the up position but not the switch position -- so it gave him the room to get it off.”

Nick Nurse on Nikola Vucevic, Apr 14, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Evan Fournier on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
.@OrlandoMagic G Evan Fournier on impassioned speech given by Nikola Vucevic Sat:

“We’re not stupid; we know that if we don’t make the playoffs this year, this is probably it for us. Just like (Vucevic) and myself, we like it (in Orlando) and we like to play with each other.”

Evan Fournier on Nikola Vucevic, Jan 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Mo Bamba on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
.@OrlandoMagic C Mo Bamba on his communication with Nikola Vucevic:

“We sent around a group text and I welcomed (Vucevic) to fatherhood even though I don’t know what fatherhood is like. I’m really excited for him. His son is going to be very tall.”

Mo Bamba on Nikola Vucevic, Dec 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: LeBron James on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Bob Garcia:LeBron James on Nikola Vucevic:

“He has had our number this year. He has been good inside and outside.”

LeBron James on Nikola Vucevic, Nov 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.

item.title: Robert Williams on Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Adam Himmelsbach:Robert Williams on his debut and matching up against Vucevic:

“When I subbed in the game I was like, ‘I know he’s going to be strong as hell, so just go in and hold your ground.’But it was a good first match-up. Plenty more strong-ass people in the league.”

Robert Williams on Nikola Vucevic, Oct 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamHimmelsbach.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Nikola Vucevic, Tobias Harris
item.description:
Rob Hennigan on Nik Vucevic and Tobias Harris:

“We don't envision a scenario where either of those players aren't with us moving forward.”

Rob Hennigan on Nikola Vucevic, Tobias Harris, Sep 30, 2014. Source: Twitter @AlexKennedyNBA.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Craig Brackins, Nikola Vucevic
item.description:
Rod Thorn:

“They are all coming back. Lavoy has a game Friday that he's going to play in in France and then he'll be back. Brackins is already back. And then with Nikola, we hope to have him here as quickly as possible. Obviously we have to get a visa in order in order to get him here and we have to have some sort of a contract in order to do that. But all of them will be here. Everybody will be on time -- we hope Nikola will be. It may be an extra day for him.”

Rod Thorn on Craig Brackins, Nikola Vucevic, Nov 30, 2011. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.
